## Better
- Coding window: a working copy is never saved from a file that E-Sys read again meanwhile, so it cannot undo newer coding.
- Coding shortcuts never change emissions-relevant (OBD) settings, the same as changes by hand.
- Opening the same coding file twice brings its window forward instead of opening a second one.
- Full backup: when a read ends with an error and the file did not change, it is saved as what E-Sys had open, not as read from the car.
- Full backup says so when E-Sys coded a module while it ran.
- Coding read back to an earlier state shows as the newest coding again.
- Backups and copies are never left half-written under their real names.
